verdict.rationale: Claude's first-party docs describe Voice mode for complete spoken conversations with Claude. It is available on all plans across mobile, desktop and web, though it is labeled beta and built to work best on phones. The core of the story is delivered, but no evidence speaks to real-time qualities such as latency or interruption. Missing for 10: evidence of real-time/low-latency and natural turn-taking (e.g., interruption), general-availability (non-beta) status, independent or hands-on corroboration.
